summary.title: Trades for Jamal Murray (Yeet): speculative schedule bet — not recommended now
summary.headline: Re-evaluated with inseason-0.3.0 against a base that already includes the Champagnie/Bailey claim, realistic refill (6th-best FA), fresh seeds, three projection sets.
summary.verdict:
Not recommended ahead of the free Champagnie claim. Most of the title gain is Denver's 4-game playoff weeks 19-20 (schedule bet).
Brunson+Bailey→Murray helps but Yeet loses 1-6 pp playoffs (unlikely to accept); Ware+VanVleet→Murray is speculative (title up, playoffs and cat-wins down).
Revisit closer to the deadline (Mar 4) when playoff schedules and health are clearer.
